tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser and return a compact page snapshot.

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Navigate back in browser history and return a compact page snapshot.

tools.name: browser_navigate_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in browser history and return a compact page snapshot.

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload the active page and return a compact page snapshot.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resize the active page viewport in CSS pixels and return a fresh snapshot.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Return a fresh full or targeted compact snapshot of the current page.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Search one fresh snapshot and return compact actionable context.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click or double-click a ref from the latest snapshot and return a fresh snapshot.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll a snapshot ref into view or move the viewport, then return a fresh snapshot.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Enter text into a snapshot ref, optionally slowly or followed by Enter.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select one or more option values or labels in a snapshot ref.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill up to 50 fields sequentially as a non-transactional batch.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Move Chromium's native mouse to a snapshot ref and return a fresh snapshot.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a native browser key, optionally focusing a snapshot ref first, and return a fresh snapshot.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Physically drag one snapshot ref to another through Chromium's native mouse input.

tools.name: browser_drop
tools.description: Synthesize a DataTransfer drop of confined files and/or MIME strings on a snapshot ref.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: List bounded console records at a severity threshold.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: List bounded current-navigation network lifecycle records.

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.description: Return request/response details and a bounded lazy response body by stable index.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, open, select, or close browser tabs.

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss the JavaScript dialog that is pending now.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Resolve the pending file chooser with confined local files, or cancel it.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for elapsed time and/or visible-text state, then return a fresh snapshot.

tools.name: browser_get_text
tools.description: Return rendered inner text for a unique CSS selector.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript function in the page or snapshot-ref context.

target.description: Ref from the latest snapshot, such as e3

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current page as an inline PNG or JPEG image. Oversized fallback files remain available until this server process shuts down.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser; the next browser tool starts a fresh session.
